external_entities.name: colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who signs in through the identity broker and uses applications.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

external_entities.name: franchise colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague from a franchise store whose identity provider vouches for them.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Franchise colleagues do not have staff accounts with us; their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: identity provider
external_entities.description: A franchise identity provider that vouches for franchise colleagues.
external_entities.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them

external_entities.name: HR system
external_entities.description: The system that supplies colleague group membership changes to the broker overnight.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Group membership is not maintained there by hand — it comes from the HR system overnight.

processes.name: identity broker
processes.description: Signs colleagues in, issues tokens, accepts franchise identity-provider sign-in, and supplies public signing material to applications.
processes.source_excerpt: Everything colleagues use signs them in through one identity broker.

processes.name: store admin console
processes.description: An application that uses token groups to authorize changing prices and voiding transactions across stores.
processes.source_excerpt: The store admin console is one of those applications.

data_stores.name: key store
data_stores.description: A store holding the signing key used by the identity broker.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.

data_stores.name: directory
data_stores.description: The identity broker's directory containing colleagues and their group memberships.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.

data_stores.name: audit log
data_stores.description: A log to which the broker writes sign-ins.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_stores.notes: Nobody has written down what that log records, or whether it covers the franchise route.

data_flows.name: sign-in
data_flows.description: A colleague signs in to the identity broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Colleagues sign in to it from wherever they are, including their own devices at home.
data_flows.data_description: unknown

data_flows.name: issue token
data_flows.description: The identity broker issues a token carrying a staff ID and group list to a colleague.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Once the broker has signed a colleague in it issues them a token.
data_flows.data_description: A token carrying the colleague's staff id and a list of the groups they are in.

data_flows.name: change prices
data_flows.description: A colleague uses a token to change prices in the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: If the token has the store-manager group in it, the console lets the holder change prices
data_flows.data_description: A token and a request to change prices.

data_flows.name: void transactions
data_flows.description: A colleague uses a token to void transactions in the store admin console.
data_flows.source_excerpt: the console lets the holder change prices and void transactions.
data_flows.data_description: A token and a request to void transactions.

data_flows.name: fetch public half
data_flows.description: The store admin console fetches the public half of the signing key from the broker.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Applications fetch the public half from the broker to check the signature.
data_flows.data_description: The public half of the signing key.

data_flows.name: read signing key
data_flows.description: The broker accesses the signing key kept in the key store to sign tokens.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker signs tokens with a signing key it keeps in a key store.
data_flows.data_description: The signing key.

data_flows.name: pull changes
data_flows.description: The broker pulls colleague group-membership changes from the HR system once a night.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker pulls the changes once a night
data_flows.data_description: Colleague and group-membership changes.

data_flows.name: update directory
data_flows.description: The broker updates its directory with colleagues and their group memberships.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker keeps the colleagues and the groups they are in its own directory.
data_flows.data_description: Colleagues and the groups they are in.

data_flows.name: vouch sign-in
data_flows.description: The franchise identity provider vouches for a franchise colleague and the broker accepts that as a sign-in.
data_flows.source_excerpt: their own identity provider vouches for them and the broker takes that as a sign-in.
data_flows.notes: The text does not state which colleagues the provider is allowed to vouch for.
data_flows.data_description: A franchise colleague's sign-in assertion.

data_flows.name: write sign-in
data_flows.description: The broker writes sign-in events to the audit log.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The broker writes sign-ins to an audit log.
data_flows.data_description: Sign-in events.

trust_boundaries.name: corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network where the identity broker and store admin console run.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The broker runs on the corporate network.

trust_boundaries.name: home
trust_boundaries.description: The home location of colleagues' own devices used to sign in.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: including their own devices at home.

assumptions.assumption: The home boundary is controlled by a party different from the corporate system.
assumptions.basis: The text describes colleagues signing in from their own devices at home.
